scope: Controlled finite-model research diagnostics; not native ALFWorld/WebShop/LOCA results and not neural DCC training.

known_model_parity.interpretation: Known-model planning diagnostic; all individual fields are independent fair bits. Predictive-entropy ties are uniform. No learned novelty claim.

learned_finite_model.atomic_design_explanation: One bit plus paired action responses is independent of the model when the true relation is a two-bit parity; new anchors do not share latent bits.

training_protocol.full_task_reward: Only short probes and local deployment are simulated. No full long-horizon task is implemented; its terminal labels are fixed to zero by protocol.
training_protocol.public_training_feedback: Joint two-bit query and two local action responses from one shared snapshot.
training_protocol.prior_knowledge: Finite parity model class, two-read candidate grammar, response noise law, and evaluation objective are given equally to every method.
training_protocol.cost: Four environment actions per block: two reads and two snapshot branches. State creation/reset, model computation, and program enumeration are not included in this environment-action count.
training_protocol.novelty_scope: The acquisition formula is classical EVSI. This experiment diagnoses the need for complete conditional programs; it does not establish a new program-discovery algorithm or native performance.
